setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step pattern through the test MIDI device: trigs on steps 1 to 4 (the channel range) with notes C3, D3, E3 and F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97. Tempo is the default 90 BPM, Rate is /1 (sixteenth-note steps, one sixth of a second each) and the sequencer is stopped. The norns shows channel 1's Device screen and every Mosaic option is at its default. Lock merged to pent. is at its default On. Only pattern 1 exists and is assigned to channel 1; patterns 2 and 3 are built in the next steps.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC, select Lock merged to pent. and turn E3 left to Off. The default is On. The row shows Off; this option only affects notes produced by merge modes.
steps.title: Turn Lock merged to pent. Off

steps.caption: Close the menu. Press Pattern (5,8), choose pattern 1 at (1,1) and tap (1,7), (2,5), (3,3) and (4,1) to rewrite its four notes as scale degrees I, III, V, VII (C E G B). The four notes light on the grid.
steps.title: Enter pattern 1

steps.caption: Choose pattern 2 at (2,1), add four trigs on steps 1 to 4 and tap (1,5), (2,3), (3,1) and (4,7): degrees III, V, VII, I (E G B C). Pattern 2 is a second voice that overlaps pattern 1 on every step.
steps.title: Enter pattern 2

steps.caption: Choose pattern 3 at (3,1), add four trigs on steps 1 to 4 and put their notes on the top row, (1,1) to (4,1); the four top-row notes light. Pattern 3 will never be assigned to the channel. It is only a velocity source: every trig has the default velocity 100, and its notes are ignored by the merge, so the notes you hear come only from patterns 1 and 2.
steps.title: Build pattern 3 as a velocity source

steps.caption: Press Channel (3,8), tap pattern slot 2 at (2,2) so patterns 1 and 2 are both assigned, then press the trig merge key at (14,8) twice. Strategy moves from Skip to Only to ALL and the key lights at medium brightness. With Skip every step both patterns share would be silenced; ALL lets every trig sound.
steps.title: Choose Strategy ALL

steps.caption: Hold the velocity merge key (16,8), tap pattern slot 3 at (3,2) and release. Slots 1 and 2 stay lit as the assigned patterns and slot 3 stays dim because it is not assigned: it only supplies the velocity of the merged notes. Note merge stays on its default, Average.
steps.title: Take velocity from pattern 3

steps.caption: Press Play (1,8), listen to two loops and press Play again to stop. The average of each step's degrees is II, IV, VI, IV, which in C major is D, F, A, F. With Lock merged to pent. Off the merged degrees play unchanged: 62, 65, 69, 65 (D F A F) at velocity 100, taken from pattern 3. Compare the On lesson, where the F steps snap to E.
steps.title: Hear the averaged phrase unchanged

steps.caption: Tap the note merge key at (15,8) once; it brightens as Note merge moves from Average to Higher. Press Play (1,8), listen to two loops and press Play again to stop. Higher adds the spread (the highest minus the lowest degree) to the rounded average, so the four steps become degrees IV, VI, VIII and X: F, A, C and E in C major. Lock merged to pent. Off leaves the F alone, so the MIDI strip "MIDI sent in this step" shows 65, 69, 72, 76 at velocity 100. Compare the On lesson, where the first step snaps to E (64).
steps.title: Switch Note merge to Higher and listen

title: Lock merged notes to pentatonic: Off
